name: razor-code-formatter
description: Prettier-grade Razor (.cshtml / .razor) formatter for VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Formatting Razor files requires workspace trust to prevent executing untrusted binaries.

razorFormatter.serverMode.description: Run Razor Formatter as a persistent background daemon for sub-millisecond formatting without process restart overhead.

razorFormatter.indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

razorFormatter.attributeLayout.description: HTML and Tag Helper attribute layout strategy.

razorFormatter.cliPath.description: Optional custom path to the razor-format CLI executable or .dll. Configurable only in User/Machine settings for security.
